title: Simulation of Time-of-Use Billing for Interval Meters
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
Reuse of Rate and Interface for Other Customer Groups

1. You can copy a time-of-use interface (Create from Template) and change the consumption periods.

2.|In the rate facts, allocate the new interface to a different fact group (for example, Residential Customers South).

3. For the operands, enter the same result parameters as operand values.

Simulation of Time-of-Use Billing for Interval Meters

Use

The time-of-use interface provides you with a simulation mode that you can use to simulate billing for interval meters in SAP EDM.
The following forms of simulation are supported:

Simulation on the Basis of Master Data

e Budget billing simulation (for example during move-in, except in the express transaction Change Budget Billing Amount
EA61EX)

e Unbilled revenue reporting (mass billing of simulation indexes)

e Billing simulation without a billable billing order

You can execute the simulation as an individual or mass activity.

i Note
Note that unbilled revenue reporting is significantly more runtime-intensive than billing conventional discrete interval meters.

Prerequisites

You have activated the business function Utilities, Advanced Metering Infrastructure 3 (ISU AMI_ 3) and also made the following

settings:

Activity                                                                   Path:

Define Consumption Pattern                                           SAP Implementation Guide >» SAP Utilities » Contract Billing > Billing
Master Data » AMI: Time-of-Use Interface » Define Consumption Pattern

Change Consumption Pattern to Synthetic Profile               SAP Easy Access » SAP menu > Utilities Industry > Billing * Master Data

Assignment                                                             AMI: Time-Of-Use Interface » Change Consumption Pattern to Profile
Assignment

Edit Time-of-Use Interface                                               SAP Implementation Guide »* SAP Utilities » Contract Billing > Billing

Master Data » AMI: Time-of-Use Interface » Edit Time-of-Use Interface

or

SAP Easy Access SAP menu » Utilities Industry Billing Master Data
AMI: Time-Of-Use Interface » Edit Time-Of-Use Interface
